dct_description_sm: Data were collected in order to reconstruct the trophic history of lake Carheil located near the town of Fermont in subarctic Qubec, Canada. These data are currently being collected and used to characterize the natural state of the lake before the arrival of human populations in the area and to determine the origin of the pollution issues currently affecting the water quality.
dct_title_s: 2015 limnological and paleolimnological data on lakes surrounding the town of Fermont, Qubec (Canada)
